method: Pages rendered at 200 dpi with music_pages.py render (listening 2-6, 8, 9, 12, 13; composing 3, 5, 7-13) and read whole; every in-scope line re-read in a 400 dpi clip to settle apostrophes (curly vs straight), dashes (en dash vs hyphen), superscripts and commas. Neither booklet has a usable text layer, so the renders are the only source. I typed my own transcription of every in-scope string from the renders without copying the reading file, then diffed it against the file by machine. Line breaks and spacing were collapsed, "\n• " was treated as equal to " • ", and the " • " joiner was ignored. Strings were compared both with and without bullet markers, and the non-ASCII code points of every string were listed. No ligature, non-breaking or stray characters were found.

Arise, fair sun, and kill the envious moon Who is already sick and pale with grief. The opening line has been set to music below. • Set the remaining words to make a melody of 16 bars. notes: Composing Q1 and Q3 instrument lists: the page prints each option after a shadowed 3-D tick box (the nearest Unicode is ❒ U+2752); the file uses □ U+25A1, as the coordinator's ruling names it. This is a rendering of an answer box, not a printed character, so it is not counted as a difference.
Composing Q1 prints '16–bar' with an en dash (U+2013) and Q3 prints '16-bar' with a hyphen. The file has the same, and the two dashes visibly differ in length at 400 dpi.
Composing Q3 'Use the form AA¹BB¹.': both 1s are printed superscript and the file has U+00B9 twice. This agrees with the existing readFromPage entry.
'PREPARATORY WORK' (composing Q4-Q6) is printed in true capitals in a lighter serif, not in small caps of mixed-case text, so the file's capitals match.

Listening Q6(e)-(h): page 13 prints 'Excerpt 3, played three times. The lyrics are printed below.' as one bold line with no bullet, so the file's run-on form is right there. It differs from Q1 and Q5 A, which print the lyrics line as a separate bullet.
The 'Q. 1' to 'Q. 6' and 'Q.1' to 'Q.6' question labels are left out of every string, which is the lane's convention; this is not counted as a difference.
